enriched_description: Portable clamshell computer with a flat rectangular display screen hinged to a base unit containing a keyboard and trackpad. The screen measures 13-17 inches diagonally with a thin bezel surrounding the display panel. Base unit has a smooth metallic or plastic surface with a full QWERTY keyboard layout and a rectangular touch-sensitive trackpad centered below the spacebar. Overall dimensions approximately 30-40 cm wide by 20-28 cm deep by 1.5-3 cm thick when closed. Surface finish ranges from brushed aluminum to matte black plastic. When open, the screen tilts back at approximately 100-120 degrees from the base.

Garden tool for cutting grass with a horizontal rotating blade housed beneath a deck-shaped body. Features a flat rectangular or rounded deck approximately 40-55 cm wide, mounted on four wheels. A vertical handle extends upward and rearward from the deck for the operator to push. The deck underside houses a sharp metal blade spinning at high speed, with a discharge chute or collection bag attached to the side or rear. Body construction is painted steel or molded plastic in green, black, or red. Engine housing sits atop the deck for powered models, with a pull-start cord visible.

Small circular protective cap designed to snap or screw onto the front of a camera lens. Made of black plastic with a smooth matte surface, featuring a slightly domed or flat top. Diameter matches common lens filter sizes ranging from 49mm to 82mm. The inner rim has a friction-fit grip or threaded interior for secure attachment. Some models include a small pinch grip or center snap mechanism for easy removal. Thickness approximately 5-10 mm. Surface may have manufacturer branding embossed on the top face.

Dull-bladed desk tool with a tapered pointed tip and a smooth elongated blade approximately 15-20 cm long. The blade has a rounded non-sharpened edge designed to slide under envelope seals without cutting contents. Handle may be integrated into the blade as a single piece or feature a decorative grip made from wood, metal, bone, or plastic. Blade surface is polished metal (stainless steel, brass, or silver) with a reflective finish. Overall shape resembles a narrow dagger or stylus with a gradual taper from handle to tip.

Multi-story building with a formal architectural facade featuring large windows, columns, or decorative stonework. Interior characterized by tall rows of wooden or metal bookshelves filled with books organized in systematic order. Reading areas include long wooden tables with chairs, individual study carrels, and reference desks. Lighting is a combination of natural light from large windows and overhead fluorescent or LED fixtures. Floors are typically carpeted or hardwood. Signage indicates section categories. Exterior often displays institutional architecture with symmetrical design and prominent entrance.

Sturdy small boat designed for emergency evacuation from a larger vessel at sea. Features a rigid hull construction of fiberglass, aluminum, or reinforced plastic with a flat or V-shaped bottom. The boat has high freeboard sides for stability in rough seas, with oarlocks for manual rowing and/or a small outboard motor mount at the stern. Capacity markings and safety equipment are visible on the interior. Color is typically bright orange, yellow, or white for high visibility. Length ranges from 5-10 meters with a beam of 2-3 meters. Davit attachment points are visible on the hull sides.

Compact handheld ignition device with a rectangular or cylindrical body approximately 5-8 cm tall. Features a metal or plastic casing with a hinged lid (flip-top style) or a fixed top with a spark wheel. The ignition mechanism includes a flint wheel or piezoelectric button that produces a flame from a fuel nozzle. Surface finish ranges from brushed chrome to colored enamel with printed designs. Fuel reservoir is internal, filled with butane or lighter fluid. The flame emerges from a small metal tube at the top when activated.

Large luxury sedan with an elongated body and extended wheelbase, typically black or dark-colored with a glossy paint finish. The passenger compartment is separated from the driver by a partition window. Extended rear doors provide access to a spacious rear seating area with leather upholstery, ambient lighting, and premium amenities. Body length exceeds 5 meters, with the rear section noticeably stretched compared to standard sedans. Chrome trim accents the grille, window surrounds, and door handles. Tinted rear windows provide privacy. Multi-spoke alloy wheels complete the upscale appearance.

Large multi-deck passenger ship with a streamlined hull and superstructure rising several stories above the waterline. The hull is painted dark (typically black or navy) with a white upper superstructure and a distinctive funnel or smokestack bearing company colors. Multiple rows of portholes or balcony windows line the hull sides. The bow has a pointed profile cutting through water, with a visible wake behind the stern. Deck features include lifeboats mounted along the sides, open deck areas with railings, and recreational facilities. Overall length exceeds 200 meters for modern ocean liners.

Cylindrical cosmetic product housed in a slim tube approximately 7-10 cm tall with a twist-up mechanism. The lipstick bullet is a solid wax-based colored cylinder that extends from the top of the tube when twisted. Tube casing is made of metal or plastic with a glossy or matte finish, often in black, gold, silver, or brand-specific colors. The bullet tip is angled or rounded for application. Color of the lipstick ranges from natural nude tones to vibrant reds, pinks, and dark shades. Cap covers the bullet when closed, often clicking into place.
